arylpiperazines with a substituted 4-(3-(2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-1-yl)propoxy)phenyl group at the 4-position of the piperazine ring showed potent in vitro cytotoxic activity against LNCa P and DU145 cells.

arylpiperazinyl compounds 9, 14 and 15 showed significant cytotoxic activity against prostate cancer cells.

the synthesis of arylpiperazinyl derivatives as a new type of potential anticancer agent.
the development of a new class of arylpiperazines as potential antiproliferative agents for prostate cancer.
the design, synthesis, and biological activity evaluation of a series of novel arypiperazine derivatives.

the arylpiperazines are a class of promising anticancer agents for further development.

arylpiperazines are not selective cytotoxic agents for human prostate cancer cells.

the cytotoxic activities of arylpiperazines were not only related to the substitution pattern of the aryl moiety but also to the length of the piperazine chain.
